summary:
Read-only fidelity check of sub-slice 1f against the brief (1f.md), plan sections 2.4–2.8 and 8, spec v4 (ES-7, ES-9, UN-1 to UN-3, EN-2's last bullet, A4, A27) and the user's third mid-turn message. I made no repository writes and no git changes. I regenerated the builder's patch from orig/ and new-files.txt, and it is byte-identical to b1f/1f.patch, so the patch matches the working tree.

The diff does what the brief asks, item by item. I found 2 minor issues and 2 nits.

**A. Host.** Every action message is refused before planning with core EDIT_SESSION_ACTIVE (code `conflict`), using the brief's exact text. That covers addNode, editNode, deleteNode, kindChange, reorder, theseSuffice, createSubject, addArrows, removeArrows, setFromNothing, claimPending and moveCards, plus undo, redo and historyRevert. The lock applies while the root's run is in any non-terminal state, on any subject. That matches the RunManager's own idea of an active run, and current() keeps returning the saved non-terminal view until endRun persists. The lock also holds while a start is on its way. Viewing, history listing and preview, copy, open, refresh, Keep last N, initGit and every run message are still allowed.
- I checked that no other host path changes files. There are only 3 VS Code commands and no undo keybinding, every webview message goes through BoardSession.handle, and the extension's api.ts is test-only.

**B. Runner.** The drift refusal comes after the definitions check and before planAccept, and nothing is settled first. The text and the "up to 5, then …" format match the brief. The rebase block is kept and carries the required "unreachable since slice 1f (ES-7)" comment.
- I confirmed the base never moves. The only `base` commit is made in createRunShadow, and baseCommit is set only on the now unreachable rebase path. The shadow's writeFiles callers are adoption, normalise and rebase, and none of the first two reads the user's files.

**C. Webview.**
- Every store edit action is gated, and undo and redo are silent (A27); the Proposed view never posts an undo.
- Every UI call site of an edit action is disabled with the reason as its tooltip. No CSS sets pointer-events:none on a disabled control, so the tooltips will show.
- Drag and drop is off, D-16's switch back to Current is removed, and the Proposed view's arrow actions use the brief's reason text.

**D. Tests.** The new and changed tests cover the brief. No test was deleted: the per-file it() counts are equal or higher.

**Carry-overs and safety properties.**
- All four carry-overs are done: TL015 skips AXIOM premises, a Delete with marks is one plan with the A16 question covering all of it, TL102 is added idempotently in upgradeLegacyProposal, and the wording is "Move to axioms".
- The safety properties hold. Only the user changes kinds. TL102 is a warning and adds no status claim. Mark removal is the same edit as set-from-nothing off (follows_from line removed, block pinned), and aliases are never rewritten. Old messages, History entries and proposals still load.
- The builder's list of e2e tests that need updating matches what I found: m2-layout lines 75–80 and board.spec line 327. m2-overlay still passes because the new note text contains the old substring.

The findings below are a start-ordering claim that is only half true, a narrow Accept race that pre-dates 1f, and two documentation and deferral nits.

findings.where: packages/extension/src/logic/boardSession.ts:36, 366-369, 384-388, 453-457 (plus plan §8 'The start first waits for the board edits queued before it' and editSessionLock.test.ts:230)
findings.problem: The start ordering only half does what the docs, plan §8 and report claim ("a start first waits for board edits already queued, so the run's base includes them"). startRun increments `starting` as soon as it is invoked, and each queued edit checks the lock only when its turn comes in handleInOrder. So an edit that reached the host BEFORE the startRun message but is still waiting behind another edit under way is refused with EDIT_SESSION_ACTIVE. Only the edit already past its lock check finishes first. The user then loses an edit made before pressing Formalize: it is rolled back, with a toast saying the session is active. Safety is unaffected, because the base is still read after every accepted edit. The test 'board edits sent before the start finish first' covers only one in-flight edit.
findings.evidence: startRun: `this.starting += 1; … await this.queue; return await manager.start(...)`. editLock: `if (this.starting > 0) return EDIT_SESSION_ACTIVE;`, called inside the queued job, at processing time rather than arrival. Scenario: editNode A runs ws.perform, editNode B is queued, then startRun arrives. B's turn comes after starting>0, so B is refused although it was sent before the start.
findings.fix: Decide the start lock by arrival order. In handle(), when a startRun message arrives, synchronously bump a `startsArrived` counter, and stamp each board-queue message with the counter's value at arrival. In handleInOrder, refuse only messages that arrived after a pending start (or while a run is active), and let startRun keep awaiting `this.queue` so earlier edits finish first. Add a test with two edits queued before the start. Otherwise, at least make the boardSession.ts header and startRun comments, plan §8 and the report say that only an edit already under way finishes and queued ones are refused.

findings.problem: A4 says "Nothing is merged", but a narrow race can still merge a hand edit. Accept checks drift with `baseDrift` (one set of reads). `planAccept` then reads the real files again and 3-way merges Claude's changes onto whatever it reads. A hand edit or git checkout that lands between the two reads is merged into what Accept applies, and the combined state is never re-checked. The EditApplier's before-check only covers the later gap between planAccept and apply. The two reads also see different file lists: baseDrift uses `workspace.modelFiles()`, planAccept lists the disk, so a hand-added file the workspace has not indexed passes baseDrift. The same race existed before 1f (drift [] meant no rebase), so this is not a regression. But the new docs claim planAccept is called 'only when the real files equal the base (the patch then applies as it is)'.
findings.evidence: `const drift = await proposals.baseDrift(...); if (drift.length > 0) return refused(...); let plan = await proposals.planAccept(request);`. planAccept recomputes `drift` from its own reads (service.ts: `const drift = [...realPaths].filter(...)`) and returns it in the ok plan (AcceptPlan.drift), but the manager no longer looks at it on this path.
findings.fix: After `if (!plan.ok) return refused(plan.code, plan.error);` add `if (plan.drift.length > 0) return refused('conflict', driftRefusal(plan.drift));`. That uses the drift computed from the same reads planAccept merges, and it also covers unindexed files. Add a manager.accept unit test whose fake planAccept returns drift although baseDrift returned [].

findings.problem: The M2 design doc still describes Accept after drift as D-21's accept-base, rebase and re-gate. Since 1f that path is unreachable: Accept refuses on drift (ES-7). The 1a fixer kept m2-plan.md current with dated notes, but 1f added none, so a reader of §7.1 is misled.
findings.fix: Add a dated note at §7.1 step 4, and at item 5 of the opening summary list: 'Since slice 1f (spec v4 ES-7): drift refuses Accept, naming up to 5 files; this step is unreachable and slice 2 removes it.'

findings.problem: ES-7 and A4 also want telelean to watch the files: the session bar says the files changed, lists them, and Apply is disabled live until they match again. Slice 1 delivers only the Accept refusal, which the brief asked for, plus a note based on `proposal.baseChanged`, which is computed only when the proposal is built. A hand edit made after the proposal is built is therefore shown only when Accept is pressed. §8 mentions the staleness, but the live watcher is not listed anywhere as deferred, so it may get lost.
findings.fix: Add the file watcher (the session bar's 'Your files changed since the session started' with the files listed, and Apply disabled live, ES-7/EN-2/A4) to the plan's 'Not in slice 1' list or to the slice-2 observations in §8.

Per changed test file, compared the it()/test() counts in orig/ with the current files: no file lost a case (arrows 27->34, legacy 4->5, manager.accept 7->9, workspace/arrows 6->7, store-arrows 21->22, the others equal); so no test was deleted

grep of protocol.ts message types against ACTION_MESSAGE_TYPES + LOCKED_NON_ACTIONS: every message that changes files is locked; select/selectSubject/history*/initGit/copy/open/refresh and the run messages are not
grep of extension src for other file-changing paths (registerCommand, perform/undo/revert callers, BoardPanel routing, api.ts): none bypass BoardSession

Read manager.ts acceptNow, service.ts baseDrift/planAccept, modelWorkspace applyChanges/applyRecorded and the EditApplier's conflict guard (basis of F2)
grep for leftover 'Make Axiom' / 'Drop to make' / rebase expectations in unit tests and src: only in comments, a fake's message, and gate tests of the kept code path
